properties.project_name: Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens
properties.digitized_from: OpenStreetMap way 446183018 (leisure=park, name=Parklab) outer edge, cut at DataSF's official centerlines of Merrimac St and 4th St, plus and minus 6.8 m (4th St's roadway is excluded; the Merrimac St line falls about 2-3 m inside P13's community garden beds) into OCII's parcels P12, P13 and P15 (OCII Nov 14, 2024 update, PDF p.17)
properties.accuracy_caveat: The shape is approximate but its outer edge is real. The outer edge is OpenStreetMap way 446183018 (leisure=park, name 'Parklab', community-surveyed). The lines between the three parcels are not surveyed parcel lines: they are drawn at DataSF's official street centerlines for Merrimac St and 4th St, which are roadways across the strip, offset 6.8 m each side (checked on satellite imagery; at Merrimac St the paved crossing is only about 10-11 m wide with the centerline near its east edge, so the line on the P13 side falls about 2-3 m inside the community garden beds, leaving about 70-100 sq m of them out of P13), and the order of the parcels, P12 then P13 then P15 from west to east, is from OCII's November 14, 2024 update (PDF p.17), whose drawing is not to scale. This parcel is the easternmost of the three, between 4th St and the OSM outline's east end near 3rd St, about 4,450 sq m. The shape is not clipped to the street layer (street_clip_exempt): clipping a drawn outline against DataSF centerline buffers would cut P12 in two along DataSF's Long Bridge St segment, which crosses the soccer field where imagery shows no roadway, and would trim the north edges of P12 and P15, so the processed shape is the drawn one. This parcel has no Assessor lot of its own: Assessor lots 8732001 (1,415 sq m) and 8711005 (2,953 sq m), both active, each hold part of this parcel (about 19% and 45% of it; the parcel is about 61% and 68% of those lots), so neither lot is this parcel's own. The interim uses here are as OCII labels them (OCII's legend label "Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens"); they are interim pending the Mission Bay Future Parks Project, which is planned to redesign parcels P12, P13 and P15 into a permanent park (expected dates differ by source; see the record page).

properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's real-site pass: real, community-surveyed OpenStreetMap boundary (way 446183018), the same pattern already used for Pier 70's Crane Cove Park (data/manual/pier70_crane_cove_park.geojson) -- not a hand trace or plan-diagram estimate. MEDIUM CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon for the current interim installation (Parklab Gardens; the wider parcel also hosts Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens mini golf, Urban Sprouts community garden and an SFF soccer field per SF Rec & Park's own Future Parks Project page). Marked 'existing' rather than 'complete' because this is explicitly an interim use, not the plan's final build-out: OCII's Mission Bay Future Parks Project will redesign parcels P12/P13/P15 into a permanent, unified extension of the Commons (planning 2024-25, design mid-2026, construction targeted late 2028, public opening targeted early 2030). This feature traces only the Parklab Gardens sub-area, the most clearly-bounded of several interim uses on the same parcels -- a second pass could digitize the soccer-field/Stagecoach Greens portions separately. SOURCES ADDED 2026-09-23: the owner asked whether the P12/P13/P15 sources included SF Rec & Park's own community-workshop decks -- they didn't yet. Found and verified all three (each fetched directly, not just linked): Community Meeting #1 (Jun 2, 2024), #2 (Oct 29, 2024) and #3 (Apr 29, 2025, 83 pages) -- #3 has individually labeled concept-plan pages for P12, P13 and P15 (soccer pitches and outdoor fitness on P12; food trucks, outdoor dining and a pavilion on P15, matching Spark Social SF's current use of that parcel) plus an alternative option for P12. These are design-workshop concepts, not an adopted final plan -- the design team was only selected via an Aug 2025 OCII/MBDG RFQ, after Workshop 3. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: corrections to the description above. (1) The sentence 'This feature traces only the Parklab Gardens sub-area' is wrong: the mapped polygon is OSM way 446183018 (leisure=park, name 'Parklab', about 14,665 sq m, roughly 420 m long), the whole Parklab park strip, which fully contains the Parklab Gardens way (437595662) and the Spark Social SF way (437591532). (2) P15's food-truck/outdoor-dining/pavilion concept does not match Spark Social SF's use: OCII's Nov 14, 2024 CAC update puts Spark Social SF on P13 and Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens on P15. (3) 'The design team was only selected via an Aug 2025 OCII/MBDG RFQ' overstates it: SF Rec & Park's Future Parks page says an RFQ was released in early August 2025 and a design team 'should be selected by mid-October'; it does not report that a selection happened. (4) digitized_from now states the OSM tag as leisure=park (was leisure=garden). (5) The planning schedule is now stated as SF Rec & Park's page gives it (planning 2024-2025, design mid-2026); the Workshop 3 deck p.15 shows construction 'mid-2027 thru 2028'. 2026-10-12 -- notes now also quote the Rec & Park page's 'anticipated to be complete by 2028' and OCII's Nov 14, 2024 deck line 'Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)' (PDF p.9), and say all are expected dates; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type. Previous wording of the changed passage: 'its Workshop 3 deck (p.15) shows construction "mid-2027 thru 2028", so the schedules differ.'. 2026-10-12 accuracy audit (schedule wording in accuracy_caveat; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type): accuracy_caveat gave 'construction targeted late 2028, public opening targeted early 2030' without the other expected dates. Read this session: sfrecpark.org/1832 'Estimated Project Schedule Planning , 2024-2025 Design , Mid 2026 Construction begins , Late 2028 Open to the Public , Early 2030' and, in the same page text, 'the remaining parks to be developed. These are anticipated to be complete by 2028'; OCII's Nov 14, 2024 CAC update (PDF p.9, timeline) 'Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)'; Rec & Park's Workshop 3 deck (Apr 29, 2025, p.15, timeline slide read from a rendering) 'Construction (mid-2027 thru 2028)' and 'Transfer to SF Rec & Park (2028 / upon completion)'. All are expected dates (an estimate, not an event) and they differ, so accuracy_caveat now lists each with its source. Previous wording of the changed passage: 'OCII's Mission Bay Future Parks Project will redesign parcels P12/P13/P15 into a permanent, unified extension of the Commons (planning 2024-25, design mid-2026, construction targeted late 2028, public opening targeted early 2030).' 2026-10-17 (text only; no change to the shape): renamed from 'Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west)' to 'Mission Bay Commons, Parcels P12, P13 and P15' (naming pass 2; the record's changelog row gives the source). The old name remains a search name; the tracing history is unchanged. 2026-10-24 -- SPLIT (outline change): the single polygon (OSM way 446183018, all of P12, P13 and P15, geometry_type 'real', about 14,655 sq m) is replaced by the P15 part of it only; P12 and P13 are now data/manual/mission_bay_commons_p12.geojson and mission_bay_commons_p13.geojson, and this file keeps its id for P15 so its history, changelog rows and links stay attached. Renamed from 'Mission Bay Commons, Parcels P12, P13 and P15' to 'Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens'; geometry_type changed from 'real' to 'approximate' because the parcel lines are drawn, not surveyed (the outer edge is still the real OSM edge). The earlier entries above describe the whole-strip polygon, which is why they say 'the whole Parklab park strip'. Method: the old outline (OSM way 446183018, about 14,655 sq m, 420 m long on its long axis) was cut at the two cross streets that are real roadways across the strip. DataSF official centerline segments Merrimac St (CNN 15008000, Mission Bay Blvd North to South) and 4th St (CNN 19985000) cross the strip at right angles about 68 m west and 79 m east of its centre; each was buffered 6.8 m either side (src/street_geometry.py's half-width) and that band removed from the outline, leaving three polygons whose outer vertices are OSM's own. Satellite imagery (Esri World Imagery, zoom 20, read by eye and with src/satellite_check.py's tile fetch) shows both as marked roadways with crosswalks, so cutting there is right in kind; how well the band fits differs. At 4th St the cut lines fall close to the crosswalk edges. At Merrimac St the paved crossing is only about 10-11 m wide and the centerline runs near its east edge, so the band's east side falls about 2-3 m inside P13's community garden beds (about 70-100 sq m of garden beds left out of P13) while its west side falls close to the paved edge; the cut was kept at the centerline plus 6.8 m rather than hand-moved, so that every line follows the same rule. The DataSF Long Bridge St centerline segment (CNN 15004000) also crosses the strip, about 19 m east of the OSM outline's west end, but the imagery shows the soccer field there and no roadway, so the strip was not cut at it and P12's west end stays as OSM has it, at the street west of the field. P15's east end stays as OSM has it: it is about 10.6 m from the centerline of 3rd St (CNN 185203) and about 3-4 m (a sidewalk width) from that street's west curb, which agrees with OCII's drawing placing 3rd St between P15 and P16 (the drawing is axonometric and not to scale, so it fixes the order of parcels and streets, not distances). Because the shape is geometry_type approximate, src/join_approximate.py would clip it against street-centerline buffers; street_clip_exempt is set so the processed shape is the drawn one (the clip would cut P12 in two along the Long Bridge St segment and trim the north edges of P12 and P15). Assessor check (data/raw/parcels.geojson, by location): lots 8710003, 8732001 and 8711005 overlap the strip; none matches any parcel at 85% both ways (details in accuracy_caveat), so no lot is used (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing', applies only to a lot that is the record's own). Source of the parcel order and names: OCII, 'Remaining Mission Bay Open Space Parcels Update', Nov 14, 2024, PDF p.17 legend 'P12 SFF Soccer + Fitness Court', 'P13 Community Garden & SPARK Social SF', 'P15 Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens' with a drawing placing P12 between Long Bridge St and Merrimac St, P13 between Merrimac St and 4th St and P15 between 4th St and 3rd St; p.5 shows P12-P15 as one strip west of P16-P17. Previous accuracy_caveat (whole strip, MEDIUM CONFIDENCE) said: 'This feature traces OSM way 446183018 (leisure=park, name Parklab, about 14,665 sq m and roughly 420 m long), the whole Parklab park strip: it fully contains the separately mapped Parklab Gardens way (437595662, about 2,212 sq m) and the Spark Social SF way (437591532, about 1,519 sq m)'; its schedule wording moved to the record page unchanged in meaning. 2026-10-25 -- review corrections (text and flag only; no change to the shape): added street_clip_exempt: true (see accuracy_caveat). The 2026-10-24 entry had said the Merrimac St and 4th St cuts 'sit on the visible curbs' and that P15's east end was 'about 10 m short of the west curb of 3rd St'. Both were wrong: at Merrimac St the cut is the centerline plus 6.8 m and falls about 2-3 m inside P13's community garden beds (about 70-100 sq m left out), and P15's east end is about 10.6 m from 3rd St's centerline (CNN 185203) and 3-4 m from its west curb. The text above now says so.
